page_title: Rajendra Prasad N - Lead Cloud & DevOps Engineer
headline: Lead Cloud & DevOps Engineer | AWS, CI/CD, Resiliency & DevSecOps
summary_html: Aggressive, results-driven Lead Cloud & DevOps Engineer with 10+ years of full software development lifecycle experience architecting large-scale, distributed applications in mission-critical environments. Deep technical expertise across Unix/Linux, AWS, Jenkins, Jules, Python, Shell scripting, and SQL. Proven track record of driving extreme resiliency, high performance, and robust Disaster Recovery (DR) postures for enterprise cloud platforms. Highly skilled at engineering advanced CI/CD automation, enforcing DevSecOps controls, supporting REST APIs, Spring Boot, and Node.js microservices, and enabling event-driven architectures leveraging JMS and cloud messaging APIs. Strong champion of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and continuous delivery, consistently partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable, and highly available infrastructure.

achievements.text: Engineered highly resilient, large-scale distributed cloud architectures on AWS, strictly enforcing disaster recovery, performance optimization, and rigorous failover testing.
Architected aggressive deployment automation strategies using Jenkins, Jules, and GitLab CI, accelerating release velocity while embedding TDD, security scanning, and automated testing.
Led DevOps enablement for high-throughput Spring Boot, Node.js, and REST API microservices, optimizing runtime environments across EKS and native AWS.
Provisioned and scaled infrastructure for event-driven architectures, integrating messaging platforms including JMS, AWS SNS/SQS, and Kafka to decouple enterprise domains.
Hardened platform security posture by systematically integrating IAM, policy-driven DevSecOps controls, MFA, and continuous application security scanning directly into CI/CD workflows.
